partnership_angle: Referral partner / validator — with a timing caveat. Operationally MHM is still an ideal profile: 16-person senior-only team, founder-led delivery, SME/SaaS clientele, Drata + Vanta ecosystem fluency, and a value-vs-Big-4 positioning that pairs naturally with a 'run this scan first, arrive 80% ready' pitch. However, MHM was acquired in June 2026 by Axiom GRC (PE-backed, ~1,500 staff, 7 acquisitions since 2024), so partnership decisions may now route through group leadership, and Axiom may push its own readiness/advisory arms (e.g., sister firm IS Partners) instead of third-party tools. Best motion: get Mark Mandel or Jose Costa on a validator call quickly while founders still steer client relationships; if group politics block a formal referral deal, treat them as a sandbox tester whose validation quote carries ex-PwC credibility across the Canadian startup market.
pitch_note: Hi Mark — you built MHM to give smaller companies Big-4-quality SOC 2 audits without the Big-4 drag, and that's exactly the client LoxeAI serves: lean AWS-native startups walking into their first audit unprepared. Would you take 30 minutes to run our automated SOC 2 readiness scan against a sandbox AWS environment and tell us, auditor-to-builder, where it holds up and where it doesn't? If it earns your validation, your pre-audit clients get a 'run this scan first — it gets you 80% ready' head start, and your team gets cleaner, faster Type 2 engagements on the Drata/Vanta evidence you already work with.
